auditor_value: Five forces: weight at the centre (down); normal reactions at A and B along the radii toward the shell's centre; friction forces at A and B tangent to the shell surface

findings.quote: normal reaction Nₐ and friction fₐ at A, and normal reaction N_B and friction f_B at B
findings.note: The two contact points use two different subscript notations for the same kind of symbol: a Unicode subscript for A (Nₐ, fₐ) and an underscore for B (N_B, f_B). A student reads Nₐ and N_B as differently styled quantities. The same mix appears in steps[1], steps[2] and steps[3].equation.
findings.fix: normal reaction N(A) and friction f(A) at A, and normal reaction N(B) and friction f(B) at B

notes: Physics agrees: weight at the midpoint (uniform rod assumed, standard), normals along the radius toward the centre, friction tangent at each end. Both mistake entries are genuine student errors.
